title: Beyond Self-Critique: Epistemic Convergence Control for Multi-Agent Research Verification
abstract: arXiv:2611.27839v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Multi-agent systems for scientific claim verification increasingly rely on role-structured LLM debate to pressure-test hypotheses. However, when debating agents are instantiated from the same underlying base model, they share identical latent representations, making self-critique bias structurally inevitable. Static fixed-iteration protocols compound this by either halting prematurely before evidence stabilizes or wasting inference compute after convergence. We present \sys{}, a multi-agent research verification framework that addresses both failure modes. translated_title: 超越自我批判：面向多智能体研究验证的认知收敛控制
translated_abstract: arXiv:2611.27839v1 公告类型：新 摘要：用于科学论断验证的多智能体系统越来越依赖角色结构化的LLM辩论来对假设进行压力测试。然而，当辩论智能体由同一底层基础模型实例化时，它们共享相同的潜在表征，使得自我批判偏差在结构上不可避免。静态固定迭代协议进一步加剧了这一问题——要么在证据稳定前过早停止，要么在收敛后浪费推理计算资源。我们提出了\Sys{}，一个同时解决上述两种失效模式的多智能体研究验证框架。首先，我们引入了一种非对称角色架构，由持有对立认知指令的倡导者、怀疑者和仲裁者组成，产生显著更低的角色嵌入相似度（0.852，对比对称多智能体辩论[MAD]的0.918，p = 5.82 × 10⁻⁸），并揭示出更多存在争议的论断（22.0%，对比MAD的15.4%）。其次，我们提出了信念差分（Belief-Delta, ΔB）收敛……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出一个多智能体研究验证框架，通过倡导者-怀疑者-仲裁者的非对称角色架构从结构上消除同源模型自我批判偏差，并利用信念差分收敛控制替代固定迭代协议，从而提升科学论断验证的可靠性与计算效率。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a multi-agent research verification framework that structurally eliminates self-critique bias from same-base-model agents via an asymmetric Advocate-Skeptic-Arbitrator role architecture, and replaces fixed-iteration debate protocols with Belief-Delta convergence control for more reliable and efficient scientific claim verification.
